# Excel reader

`xlsx.full.min.js`: SheetJS Community Edition, npm package `xlsx@0.18.5`, downloaded with npm's package integrity verification. License: Apache-2.0, included in SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt. This vendored reader supports .xls, .xlsx and SAP exports in HTML/XML formats. It runs in a dedicated Worker when the user selects a local file. No CDN calls or upload requests are required for GitHub Pages imports.
